newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIM BONDS CLOSE SOFTER WITH BUNDS, MARKKA FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: FIM BONDS CLOSE SOFTER WITH BUNDS, MARKKA FIRMER.

text.p: Markka bonds closed a touch softer with Bundsin cautious trade amid EMU uncertainties on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The market is watching the (budget) quarrels in Germany and possible French demands on employment elements in the EU stability pact. Eyes are on the EU's Amsterdam summit on Monday," one said.

The yield spread over Bunds remained steady and was seen near the current levels on Wednesday, too, dealers said. The markka ended slightly firmer in line with the DEM/SEK cross in scant dealings, operators said.
"DEM/FIM is stable, we now focus mostly on the dollar and the DEM/SEK cross," a forex dealer said. The markka was seen trading against the German mark in a 3.01-3.03 range on Wednesday.
